The '''50th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in film and television for 1992, were held on Saturday January 23, 1993 at the [[The Beverly Hilton|Beverly Hilton]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title=Pacino Gives Oscar Derby a New Twist|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1993-01-25-ca-1588-story.html|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=25 January 1993}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Thomas|first1=Rob|title='Scent,' Pacino, Thompson Take Globe Awards -- 'Roseanne' Wins Big In TV Categories|url=https://archive.seattletimes.com/archive/19930124/1681577/scent-pacino-thompson-take-globe-awards----roseanne-wins-big-in-tv-categories|access-date=14 January 2018|work=The Seattle Times|date=24 January 1993}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Weinraub|first1=Bernard|title=All Is Glittery And a Bit Odd At Golden Globes|url=https://www.nytimes.com/1993/01/25/movies/all-is-glittery-and-a-bit-odd-at-golden-globes.html|access-date=14 January 2018|work=The New York Times|date=25 January 1993}}</ref> The nominations were announced on December 29, 1992.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Fox|first1=David|title='Men' Reaches Out for a Few Good Globes|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-1992-12-30-ca-2649-story.html|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Los Angeles Times|date=30 December 1992}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Horn|first1=John|title='Good Men,' 'Aladdin' top Golden Globes|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=266&dat=19921231&id=99srAAAAIBAJ&sjid=dGQFAAAAIBAJ&pg=2738,5367817&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Kentucky New Era|date=31 December 1992}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Globe Awards taps nominees|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?nid=1320&dat=19921230&id=QkAjAAAAIBAJ&sjid=ZuoDAAAAIBAJ&pg=1413,9331949&hl=de|via=Google News Archive|access-date=14 January 2018|work=Gainesville Sun|date=30 December 1992}}</ref>
